title: Las sombras del paraíso: Desigualdad, migraciones y monocultivos
goal: Critique contemporary socioeconomic challenges: pineapple/banana monocultures, Nicaraguan labor migration, and urban-rural regional disparities.
grammar: Discurso crítico: contradicciones socioambientales y migración

sections.title: Unit 7: Costa Rica — Lesson 5
body: Welcome to lesson 5 of Unit 7 in the Latin American Regional Studies track: Costa Rica: Demilitarization, Biodiversity & Democratic Welfare.
In this lesson, we explore las sombras del paraíso: desigualdad, migraciones y monocultivos, examining the country's environmental, civic, and economic models.

items: Critique contemporary socioeconomic challenges: pineapple/banana monocultures, Nicaraguan labor migration, and urban-rural regional disparities.
Master the terminology and syntax of migraciones-agroindustria-costarricense.
Deploy advanced socio-environmental vocabulary (el monocultivo, el agroquímico).
